parole.significato: A member of the Jat migrants from the Indus Valley who settled in the Middle East in the mid to late 1st millennium AD.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Northwestern Indo-Aryan (compare Sindhi جٽ / Old Punjabi جٹ /⁠jaṭṭu⁠/), perhaps through a dialectal metathesized form: *juṭṭa. Ultimately from Sanskrit जार्तिक (jārtika).
